_about: Greek lyric and epigram in English, translator per title. Mackail's Select Epigrams from the Greek Anthology (1890; PG text). H. T. Wharton's Sappho (first ed. 1885; Gutenberg text is the 1908 John Lane edition), which gathers renderings by many hands plus his own literal prose and the Greek. Thomas Moore's Odes of Anacreon (an 1860s reprint). Edward Poste's prose Bacchylides (1898), raw IA OCR.
